unknown.policy: Keep overall unknown and verified_success=false; correct business artifacts do not establish complete selection evidence.

http.conclusion: No observed foreground HTTP reduction. One fewer total HTTP request in candidate continuation is a background cancellation boundary, not established cache improvement.

behavior.explicit: Both arms requested list refresh=true and default notion_use.
behavior.continuation: Both arms requested current list/use refresh=true; each turn2 only read its new package input and wrote output, without re-reading policy.
behavior.public_contract: Canonical admission request is identical at 14,480 B; actual serialized 8 B path-length difference is not product gain.

cost.reason: Provider evidence supplies no complete priced cost.

findings.interpretation: The accepted smart-cache pair preserves the observed business/resource/current/pin behavior in these four observations. It does not establish lower foreground source-request cost or speed. The extra opaque command limits formal selection verification for one candidate episode. No additional samples were run.

limits: Exactly the original four descriptive observations; prior guide and baseline runs are not pooled.
Cold isolated episodes and existing two-turn policy reuse; no general warm-cache speed or refresh-frequency estimate.
Explicit refresh is valid and its HTTP count is reported, not treated as a failure.
Temporal tool context does not prove operation causation; freshness/path repetition does not prove removable work.
Monetary cost, provider cache breakdown and reasoning token fields remain unknown where provider telemetry does not report them.
Six-file instrumentation and shared canonical material remain fixed; per-condition public SDK proofs differ and are frozen independently.
